$\text{Slope}=\dfrac{\text{Rise}}{\text{Run}}=\dfrac{\text{Change in }y}{\text{Change in }x}$

We can calculate the change in $x$ and change in $y$ by picking any two pairs of corresponding $x$- and $y$-values.

$\begin{array}{lrrrr}
&&\xrightarrow{+3}\,\,\,\,
&\xrightarrow{+3}\,\,\,\,
&\xrightarrow{+3}\,\,\,\,
\\
x
&8
&11
&14
&17
\\
\hline
\\
y
&36
&12
&-12
&-36
\\
&&\xrightarrow[-24]{}\,\,\,\,
&\xrightarrow[-24]{}\,\,\,\,
&\xrightarrow[-24]{}\,\,\,\,
\end{array}$

So the slope is:

$\dfrac{\text{Change in }y}{\text{Change in }x}=\dfrac{-24}{3}=-8$

question.content:
